source: Five product photographs and one message screenshot supplied by Brice. Originals are not published.

ingredients_as_photographed: Steviol glycosides (from organic Stevia rebaudiana leaf)
bone_broth_protein.protein_source: Collagen-rich beef protein isolate; not whey.
bone_broth_protein.manufacturer_claim: Side label describes HydroBEEF as containing both complete and collagen proteins. Manufacturer webpage describes all essential amino acids. These are manufacturer statements, not an independent amino-acid assay.
bone_broth_protein.label_mixing_information: 27 g in 8 ounces of water or another beverage; label information only, not a prescribed drink or timing.
bone_broth_protein.lot_note: Lot and expiry not visible in the supplied protein photos.

creatine.lot_note: A lot/expiry stamp is photographed; angled print needs confirmation before an exact lot is used for verification.

intake_report.date_basis: Same-day coach conversation context; screenshot says Today, without an absolute date.
intake_report.later_report_context: Reported before the planned run and dinner; not a claim of eating immediately before running.
intake_report.lunch_reported: Rice, beans and rotisserie chicken from La Granja.
intake_report.meal_size_feedback: Athlete described the large lunch as difficult to finish.
intake_report.interpretation: An intake self-report plus a meal-size concern. No calorie target, measured surplus, muscle gain, or success from forcing food is inferred.
intake_report.coaching_response: Record the full day and comfortable meal sizes. Do not force a larger meal to beat a number or add pre-run food.

boundaries.timing_owner: Treating clinician; coach implements reviewed guidance.
